verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Eliphaz the Temanite . . . replied

verses.original: הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן־ גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי־ יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: hal·’êl yis·kān- gā·ḇer kî- yis·kōn ‘ā·lê·mōw maś·kîl
verses.literal: Can a man be of use to God Can even a wise man benefit Him

verses.original: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם־ בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי־ תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥê·p̄eṣ lə·šad·day kî ṯiṣ·dāq wə·’im- be·ṣa‘ kî- ṯat·têm də·rā·ḵe·ḵā
verses.literal: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous . . . Does He profit if your ways are blameless

verses.original: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hă·mî·yir·’ā·ṯə·ḵā yō·ḵî·ḥe·ḵā yā·ḇō·w ‘im·mə·ḵā bam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין־ קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō rā·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā rab·bāh wə·’ên- qêṣ la·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Is not your wickedness great Are not your iniquities endless . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯaḥ·bōl ’a·ḥe·ḵā ḥin·nām ū·ḇiḡ·ḏê ‘ă·rūm·mîm tap̄·šîṭ
verses.literal: For you needlessly demanded security from your brothers and deprived the naked of their clothing

verses.original: לֹא־ מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ma·yim ‘ā·yêp̄ taš·qeh ū·mê·rā·‘êḇ tim·na‘- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the famished

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš zə·rō·w·a‘ lōw hā·’ā·reṣ ū·nə·śū p̄ā·nîm yê·šeḇ bāh
verses.literal: while the land belonged to a mighty man and a man of honor lived on it

verses.original: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·mā·nō·wṯ šil·laḥ·tā rê·qām ū·zə·rō·‘ō·wṯ yə·ṯō·mîm yə·ḏuk·kā
verses.literal: You sent widows away empty-handed and the strength of the fatherless was crushed

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā p̄a·ḥîm wî·ḇa·hel·ḵā pa·ḥaḏ piṯ·’ōm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . snares surround you and sudden peril terrifies you

verses.original: אוֹ־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־ תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת־ מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ḥō·šeḵ lō- ṯir·’eh wə·šip̄·‘aṯ- ma·yim tə·ḵas·se·kā
verses.literal: it is so dark you cannot see and a flood of water covers you

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽלֹא־ אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי־ רָֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hălō- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah gō·ḇah šā·mā·yim ū·rə·’êh rōš kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm kî- rām·mū
verses.literal: Is not God as high as the heavens Look at the highest stars how lofty they are

verses.original: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה־ יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā mah- yā·ḏa‘ ’êl haḇ·‘aḏ ‘ă·rā·p̄el yiš·pō·wṭ
verses.literal: Yet you say What does God know Does He judge through thick darkness

verses.original: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר־ ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇîm sê·ṯer- lōw wə·lō yir·’eh wə·ḥūḡ šā·ma·yim yiṯ·hal·lāḵ
verses.literal: Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven

verses.original: הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי־ אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ō·raḥ ‘ō·w·lām tiš·mōr ’ă·šer dā·rə·ḵū mə·ṯê- ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר־ קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא־ עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- qum·mə·ṭū wə·lō- ‘êṯ nā·hār yū·ṣaq yə·sō·w·ḏām
verses.literal: They were snatched away before their time and their foundations were swept away by a flood

verses.original: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה־ יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mə·rîm lā·’êl sūr mim·men·nū ū·mah- yip̄·‘al šad·day lā·mōw
verses.literal: They said to God Depart from us What can the Almighty do to us

verses.original: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mil·lê ḇāt·tê·hem ṭō·wḇ wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ rə·šā·‘îm rā·ḥă·qāh men·nî
verses.literal: But it was He who filled their houses with good things so I stay far . . . from the counsel of the wicked

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’ū ṣad·dî·qîm wə·yiś·mā·ḥū wə·nā·qî yil·‘aḡ- lā·mōw
verses.literal: The righteous see it and are glad the innocent mock them

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō niḵ·ḥaḏ qî·mā·nū wə·yiṯ·rām ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’êš
verses.literal: Surely . . . our foes are destroyed and fire has consumed their excess

verses.original: הַסְכֶּן־ נָ֣א עִמּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: has·ken- nā ‘im·mōw ū·šə·lm bā·hem tə·ḇō·w·’aṯ·ḵā ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him thereby good will come to you

verses.original: קַח־ נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ- nā mip·pîw tō·w·rāh wə·śîm ’ă·mā·rāw bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Receive . . . instruction from His mouth and lay up His words in your heart

verses.original: אִם־ תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד־ שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tā·šūḇ ‘a·ḏō·ša- šad·dai tib·bā·neh tar·ḥîq ‘aw·lāh mê·’ā·ho·le·ḵā
verses.literal: If you return to the Almighty you will be restored If you remove injustice from your tents

verses.original: וְשִׁית־ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šîṯ- ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār bā·ṣer ū·ḇə·ṣūr nə·ḥā·lîm ’ō·w·p̄îr
verses.literal: and consign your gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh šad·day bə·ṣā·re·ḵā wə·ḵe·sep̄ tō·w·‘ā·p̄ō·wṯ lāḵ
verses.literal: then the Almighty will be your gold and the finest silver for you

verses.original: כִּי־ אָ֭ז עַל־ שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’āz ‘al- šad·day tiṯ·‘an·nāḡ wə·ṯiś·śā ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God

verses.original: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ta‘·tîr ’ê·lāw wə·yiš·mā·‘e·kā ū·nə·ḏā·re·ḵā ṯə·šal·lêm
verses.literal: You will pray to Him and He will hear you and you will fulfill your vows

verses.original: וְֽתִגְזַר־ א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ וְעַל־ דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯiḡ·zar- ’ō·w·mer wə·yā·qām lāḵ wə·‘al- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā nā·ḡah ’ō·wr
verses.literal: Your decisions . . . will be carried out and light will shine on your ways

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hiš·pî·lū wat·tō·mer gê·wāh wə·šaḥ ‘ê·na·yim yō·wō·ši·a‘
verses.literal: When men are brought low and you say Lift them up then He will save the lowly . . .

verses.original: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי־ נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yə·mal·lēṭ ’î- nā·qî wə·nim·laṭ bə·ḇōr kap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: He will deliver even one who is not innocent rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands
